front: Edit this brown spider game sprite into a cohesive hand-drawn 2D ink-and-flat-gouache game style. Keep the same frontal pose, proportions, two brown body segments, amber eyes, small mouth palps, EXACTLY FOUR long separate walking legs each side (8 total), all tips in frame. Change the rendering strongly: remove ALL furry, gritty, rocky, photo/3D textures and tiny surface speckles. Simple elegant rounded silhouette with crisp flowing dark chocolate ink outlines, broad flat warm chestnut brown fills, only TWO clean shadow tones and one restrained caramel highlight shape per segment. Like a delicate storybook pen-and-gouache insect, NOT plastic 3D, not pixel art. Keep existing dark leaf emblems but simplify into three clean bold strokes. Eyes large and readable amber with black pupils and one ivory catchlight. Surface smooth matte with essentially NO texture. Leg shapes slightly tapered and graceful, four distinctly spaced arching legs on EACH side, do not merge legs. Needs to look clear at 60px gameplay size and 200px menu portrait. Transparent background, no shadow, no environment, no text or accessories. Centered full sprite, modest margin.
